title: Housekeeper
experience: Our client operates a boutique 9-bedroom guest house in Rabat, offering guests a comfortable and welcoming accommodation experience
description_text:
Our client operates a boutique 9-bedroom guest house in Rabat, offering guests a comfortable and welcoming accommodation experience.
 They are looking for a reliable and hardworking Housekeeper to help maintain the property to a consistently high standard and ensure guests enjoy a clean, comfortable, and welcoming environment.
 About the Role
 The Housekeeper will be responsible for the daily cleaning and upkeep of guest rooms and communal areas throughout the 9-bedroom property.
 This role is ideal for someone who is detail-oriented, organised, takes pride in their work, and is comfortable working independently to ensure the property is maintained to a high standard.
 Key Responsibilities
 Clean and maintain guest bedrooms, bathrooms, and communal areas to a high standard.
 Make and change beds and ensure rooms are properly prepared for incoming guests.
 Clean and maintain floors, surfaces, furniture, and other areas throughout the property.
 Handle laundry, including washing, drying, folding, and organising linen and towels.
 Ensure guest rooms are fully stocked with required amenities and supplies.
 Maintain cleanliness and order in all common areas.
 Identify and report any maintenance issues, damages, or items requiring attention.
 Follow appropriate cleaning and hygiene standards at all times.
 Ensure the property is consistently presented in a clean, tidy, and welcoming condition.
 Assist with other housekeeping duties as required.
 Requirements
 Currently residing in Malta. 
 Previous experience in housekeeping, cleaning, or a similar role is preferred.
 Reliable, hardworking, and responsible.
 Strong attention to detail and pride in maintaining high standards.
 Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
 Good organisational and time-management skills.
 Flexible approach to working hours, including weekends.
 Ability to work efficiently in a hospitality environment.
 Professional and respectful approach towards guests and colleagues.
 Are you reliable, hardworking, and take pride in creating a clean and welcoming environment? Apply today and become part of a boutique hospitality team in Rabat.
